reviews.review:
Game good, thank you for reading.

In longer words

The game is qutie good I would say, the weapons feel nice to shot, the atmosphere is lovley, but i do have some issues.
One of them is that is "little" of variety of enemies. By little I mean that there are diffrent kinds of bugs but the way you fight them is usually the same, shot in the weak spot, repeat and that gets borring quite quickly.
One of my favorite missions is Elimination in which you fight dreadnoughts, the way you kill them is contrasting to the usuall and it provides an interesting scenario that forces you to change up the way you play.

It would be lovley if that would happen in (other mission types/regions), some of the main cast of glyphids does change the way that they act aswell as the apearence depending in what kind of region they found themselfs, but in such a meaningless way.

A nice example of what I mean are macteras, they provide a nice alternaive that changes up the way you play by flying in the air and shooting projectiles, forcing the player to try to dodge the projectiles or try to hide from them.

As we where previously on the topic of the missions, I don't seem to have a problem with them, their staleness is getting countered with random terrain generation aswell as numerous Mutators ranging from postive effect to negative.
Which i do belivle is lovley.

Oh how could i forget about the characters that you play. They are very charming, I personally I love to hear them chatter around while doing task, but I can't not mention one glarrying issue with it, it's reapeatable, saying the same thing over and over is quite aggravating. It's understable that there is no way of recording a million voice lines to not make them repeatable, but I still I find that quite upsetting.
I really like how the four classes fill out each other, the outliner to that is of course enginer and scout.
An engineer can place platforms so scout can stand on them to mine stuff, it's simple but it allows for a really. communicative expirence.

The ability to change your weaponary is nice, it allows you to change up the game ext, but what about the upgrades??
I find them quite "cool", but I have a little feeling that some of them are less than moderate especialy those that you have on armor, bigger mineral bag is useless.
Oh and i wish that you could upgrade molly, there are some perks that allow you to get some defense when standing near it, but i wish that there was something more to her.

It's a nice game that has some potential, but not sure if it will be fully utilized, but if so that would be awesome.

At first I avoided this game because of the description as a first person shooter, and I stink at FPS games. A friend talked me into it when it went on sale, though, and I'm glad he did. IMO, this is a puzzle game with some looting and shooting mixed in, not a FPS. I'm really enjoying figuring out how to get to the good stuff with the tools at hand and finding the shortest distance to the objectives.

I just can't get into it. I haven't played more than the tutorial but i'm already having serious issues with the game. 

The main area hub is too confusing. It's completely overwhelming and i don't know what to do or where to go or what does what or what menu is where. It's too cluttered and the enviroment doesn't draw attention to important things that i should know. I feel like i'm missing something and i've not even started the game yet really. 

When i started the game i was front loaded with pop ups of updates and a bunch of other stuff that i have no idea what it does. 

The camera is flicking all over the place when i move even when i've turned off all the camera shaking settings.

The shooting feels weird and floaty. You shoot and the kick back keeps snapping my screen up and down and it makes me feel nauseous and makes aiming harder than it has to be. 

I dunno what else to say. This game has amazing reviews but from what i've played of the tutorial so far i just don't think i'll enjoy it.

Really fun game to play online co-op.
Devs are awesome, everything is free to play (except cosmetics).
